study: Bounded partial price-label BERT fine-tuning feasibility; fixed already-inspected 2023 development data, not blind confirmation or alpha
target_definition: company split-adjusted daily o exit/entry minus1, less same-endpoint SPY return; cash dividends excluded; strict total-return track unchanged
checkpoint_policy: No trainable floating checkpoint cached. Require a new registration binding local safetensors BERT checkpoint/config hashes before any real training. No downloads, ONNX conversion, random real-data substitute or installation.

architecture.frozen: embeddings, encoder0..10, pooler; discard original sentiment classifier
architecture.description: Partial transformer-layer fine-tuning plus new scalar head, not full-model or head-only training
architecture.dropout: eval mode even while fitting selected parameters; deterministic without dropout

inputs.aggregation: All exact distinct original headlines per company-day, separately encoded then mean scalar prediction; same headline budget as controls
inputs.loss: MSE of company-day mean prediction versus normalized day target; one equal-weight step per day, no independent headline-label replication
inputs.failure: Any missing or overlength required title makes whole company comparator unavailable; preserve baseline rows

training.target_scaler: Company training mean/population std only; scale1 if std<1e-8
training.company_models: Independent reset from same checkpoint, fixed company order; training-only seed610+index shuffle
training.selection: None; no validation/test-driven checkpoint or hyperparameter selection

stop_rule: Check deadline/RSS/available memory before each group/chunk. Nonfinite values, coverage failure or incomplete epoch => partial/failed receipt, no heldout evaluation. All companies must finish before opening heldout text/outcomes. No budget extension/device/model fallback.
sample_policy: Exact ordered ten-session train/test IDs and full source/event proxy graph, training exit before cutoff, company-day aggregation, excluded bridges retained

evaluation.baselines: Eight saved same-row ten-session excess controls, hash checked, never refitted
evaluation.incomplete: Unavailable new-model metrics/costs, never zero or synthetic market results

LM_caveat: 1993-2025 dictionary retrieved2026 postdates2023; academic research only, no commercial permission
dry_run: Tiny random synthetic two-layer transformer tests same freezing/group-loss/update/budget engine; never FinBERT training or market performance
